dict.string: Menulens shows your paired Bluetooth devices, whether they're connected and their battery level, and connects or disconnects a device when you click it. It never pairs with new devices or sends anything.
macOS treats Wi-Fi network names as location data, so Menulens needs Location access to show your network's name and the networks around you. Your location is never stored, used or sent anywhere.
